description:
Make the MCP tool-generation parity test fail rather than pass when it cannot run node.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/cli_item_validate/validate_cli_rule_tests.rs:930-935` returns early, printing "node not available; skipping MCP parity assertion", when `node --version` fails. The test runs the MCP server's tool generator (`mcp-server/lib/tool-generator.js`) over the real schema.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The parity test fails, naming the missing tool, when node cannot run.
- [hard] REQ-02: The test has no skip path, and it still asserts the generated `jit_validate` tool's properties.
title: MCP parity test fails when node is missing
